relations.subject: Joaquim Heliodoro da Cunha Rivara
relations.role: student of mathematics, philosophy, and medicine
relations.evidence: from 1824 studies of mathematics and philosophy, from 1827 of medicine, at Coimbra. In 1828 teaching was suspended during civil war, but he concluded his studies in 1834-36.

relations.subject: Joaquim Heliodoro da Cunha Rivara
relations.evidence: he worked as a teacher and librarian at Liceu de Évora
